gemini.note: the model the free tier serves; gemini-3.5-flash refuses free-tier keys with 503

milestone.note: the free-tier Gemini model scores 70 or more on every question of a five-category round; the estimated ceiling for this model under this judge is about 60
Sonnet scores 90 or more on every question of a five-category round, by prompt adaptation alone

panel.note: one fresh question per category each round, least-used first; both versions run on the same five

holdout.note: five questions the editor never sees; the current versions are scored on them every fifth round as the progress line

prompt.note: absolute ceiling on a system prompt's word count, enforced by apply-editor
